scope: Short, matched native CPU and public GPU histories on a9. Each model at each epoch used its own CPU reference. Z_HEAT_MAX is the first node. Low-redshift cases measure recombination and heating in completely ionized gas. High-redshift cases exercise nonzero brightness temperature, transverse power and mixed ionization. Driver timings are individual runs including setup, with some cases submitted concurrently.
